notes.en: Draw weight 1. Because it can award a relic, its weight is 0 for others while any empire explores it; the lock is lifted if the explorer did not obtain the relic.

texts.en:
We have arrived inside of a violent whirlwind.

Our viewing windows are completely obscured with rippling waves of an unknown gaseous fluid.

We have been able to take a minor sample of the atmosphere, but each analysis comes back wildly different from the last. We are not sure if our instruments are in error, or if there is something inherently volatile about the material itself.

The one consistent property we have found of the sample is that it contains an abnormally large amount of astral materials.

Incidentally, we have noticed that small changes in temperature are affecting its contents greatly. We are placing it inside of an insulated container until we can study this phenomenon further.

我们的裂隙探球猛烈地颠簸着，以至于许多船员都开始感到不适。

我们在样品中发现的一个不变的特性是它包含着异常大量的星界物质。

texts.en:
We have arrived inside of a violent whirlwind.

Our viewing windows are completely obscured with rippling waves of an unknown gaseous fluid.

We have been able to take a minor sample of the atmosphere, but each analysis comes back wildly different from the last. We are not sure if our instruments are in error, or if there is something inherently volatile about the material itself.

Our Rift Sphere is being whipped around with such intensity that several of the crew are becoming uncomfortable.

The one consistent property we have found of the sample is that it contains an abnormally large amount of astral materials.

Incidentally, we have noticed that small changes in temperature are affecting its contents greatly. We are placing it inside of an insulated container until we can study this phenomenon further.

texts.zh:
以我们记录的进入点作为参照，我们继续向着大漩涡的内部推进。在我们把裂隙探球逼到极限时，它所具有的低摩擦系数对于对抗这些恶劣环境的损伤果然颇具成效，而我们也将此称为“狂风”。

如果条件不变，我们将继续进行，除非碰上什么迫使我们撤离的东西。
texts.en:
Using bearings generated from our recorded entry point, we have proceeded directly into the maelstrom. While we are certainly testing the limits of our Rift Sphere, the limited friction it inherently provides has proven effective in combating the worst ravages of what we are referring to as 'the storm.'

We will continue until we encounter a change in conditions, or are forced to retreat.

texts.zh:
我们突破了风暴。

我们现在来到了一处风平浪静的区域。

我们的裂隙探球在这里看起来完全不受到任何重力的影响，并且也没有任何的摩擦力。与刚刚经历的形成鲜明对比的是，我们现在漂浮在一个完全真空的环境中。利用这个机会，网片对风暴中遭受到的破坏进行了必要的修复。

我们现在可以在闲暇时回头看，观察风暴的“墙”，并且好好地观测了一整天。

它是一团不断碰撞的恒星系统…或者可以说，它就是整个星系。我们确实目睹了整个宇宙中天体的大规模毁灭。它们旋转、碰撞、爆炸，留下大小不一的元素云。我们能在那场灾难中幸存下来，一定要归功于极大的运气。

我们不确定这场风暴已经酝酿了多久。全尺寸行星的存在表明这是一个相对较近的现象，如果这种现象持续很长时间，那么除了尘埃肯定什么都不会留下。
texts.en:
We have breached the storm.

We are currently in an area of absolute calm.

Our Rift Sphere is affected by virtually no amount of gravity here, and there is zero friction. In stark contrast to what we have just experienced, we are floating inside of a complete vacuum. We have taken this opportunity to make some needed repairs from damage suffered inside the storm.

We are now able to look behind us and inspect the 'wall' of the storm at our leisure, and have been doing so for the past day.

It is a mass of ever colliding star systems... and in some cases, entire galaxies. We are certainly witnessing the mass destruction of an entire universe's worth of celestial objects. They spin, crash, and explode against one another - leaving clouds of elements of varying size behind. How we survived that disaster must be attributed to an extreme amount of luck.

We are not sure how long this storm has been brewing. The existence of full-sized planets indicates this is a relatively recent phenomenon, as if this were to continue for very long there would be nothing left but dust.

texts.en:
To our great surprise, we have breached the storm.

We are currently in an area of absolute calm.

Our Rift Sphere is affected by virtually no amount of gravity here, and there is zero friction. In stark contrast to what we have just experienced, we are floating inside of a complete vacuum. We have taken this opportunity to make some needed repairs from damage suffered inside the storm.

We are now able to look behind us and inspect the 'wall' of the storm at our leisure, and have been doing so for the past day.

It is a mass of ever colliding star systems... and in some cases, entire galaxies. We are certainly witnessing the mass destruction of an entire universe's worth of celestial objects. They spin, crash, and explode against one another - leaving clouds of elements of varying size behind. How we survived that disaster must be attributed to an extreme amount of luck.

We are not sure how long this storm has been brewing. The existence of full-sized planets indicates this is a relatively recent phenomenon, as if this were to continue for very long there would be nothing left but dust.

texts.zh:
我们向着风暴‘’眼”中心的探索颇为宁静。

然而，我们有点担心自己已经无法安全返航了。外面的风暴越来越强，据计算，无论锚链拉回得多快，我们的裂隙探球都几乎不可能保持完整。

现在这也不是我们最关心的事情。

我们发现了在这片平静的中心存在的什么东西。或者准确点说是两个“什么东西”。

首先是一台装置。

以我们船员的全体知识而言，它的本质不可理解。我们不完全确认我们能否观测到该物体的全部维度。他的许多几何外形崩解为碎片图样，消失成为一个点，很难详细地描述这个东西到底是什么样的构造。我们相信它是一台机器而不是什么活物。此外这里还有另一个物体。

有什么东西正在操纵这台装置。

它们俩显然是互相独立的个体。它沿着机器表面舞蹈流动，令人难以置信的轻松。如果设备上有按钮，它应该就是在按那些按钮。然而我们都确定它上面是没有按钮的。巨大的形状在生命的命令下向外拉和推。

我们觉得它没有注意到我们，而且似乎完全被它目前的活动迷住了。
texts.en:
Our journey to the center of the 'eye' of the storm has been a peaceful one.

However, we are worried we might not be able to return safely. The storm outside is gaining in intensity, and our calculations suggest our Rift Sphere has a low chance of survival even at full-speed anchor retraction.

This is not our most important concern at the moment.

We have found something at the very center of this calmness. Two 'somethings', to be quite clear.

First, there is a device.

For all of our crew's combined knowledge, it is incomprehensible in nature. We are not even fully certain we are able to observe all dimensions of this object. Many of its geometric shapes break down into fractal patterns that disappear into a single point, making it very difficult to describe the exact architecture of the thing. We do believe it is a machine, and not alive. This is where the second object comes in.

There is something manipulating the device.

It is clearly a separate entity. It dances and flows along the surface of the machine with incredible ease. If buttons were present on the device, it would appear to be pressing them. We all agree though, there are no buttons. Massive shapes pull and push outward at the being's behest.

We do not believe it has noticed us, and seems fully enthralled in its current activities.

texts.zh:
我们引起了它的注意，然后保持着高度的警惕。

我们在所有可用的光谱范围内闪动了一系列的灯。我们以一种简单的二进制模式对它们进行脉冲，以传达某种形式的意图。

那个生物停止了装置操纵，缩回到一个完全黑暗的完美的圆球里。

我们猜测，它可能在模仿我们。

我们注意到，它一停止拉推机器，我们周围的风暴强度减弱了。我们预测，它将在短短几天内达到一个完全停止的势头。然后它可能会向内坍缩。

我们随时准备收锚。
texts.en:
We have gained its attention, and remain at full alert.

We flashed a series of lights in all available spectrums. We pulsed them in a simple binary pattern to communicate some form of intent.

The being has ceased manipulating the device, and has retracted into a perfectly round sphere of complete darkness.

Our first speculation is that it may be imitating us.

We have noticed that in the time since it has stopped pulling and pushing at the machine, the storm around us has lessened in intensity. We predict it will reach a full stop in momentum in only a few days. It is possible it will then collapse inward.

We are preparing to retract our anchor at any moment.

label.zh: 一有什么异常就立刻撤离……
label.en: Retreat at any sign of danger...

texts.zh:
他忽然就消失了。

这个生物彻底地消失，只留下了这台装置。

我们周围的风暴减弱到可以安全航行的程度，而这个宇宙被破坏的程度令人咋舌。

那个实体离开了，我们应该就可以去接近那台装置。

制造它的材料不能用任何已知的设备粉碎或切断。然而，它的外壳上有一些外部的磁性机构，每个机构都以极高的速度旋转。其中一个有所松动，虽然返回的条件可能会受限，但我们能够把它装进我们的船里进行进一步的研究。

无论放在什么表面上，这个装置都会以很高的速度旋转，它的重心和动量很容使它保持直立。我们没有检测到内部电源，并相信这可能是真正的永动机的一个惊人的例子。
texts.en:
Suddenly, it is gone.

The being has disappeared completely, leaving only the device behind.

The storm around us has lessened to the point where it may be safely navigated, though the sheer scale of the cosmic destruction left behind is staggering.

With the entity gone, we felt confident enough to approach the device.

The material it is made of cannot be splintered or fractured away with any known equipment. However, there are a few external apparatuses magnetically attached to its outer casing, each spinning at an extremely high velocity. One in particular was loose, and though the return conditions are likely to be cramped, we were able to load it inside of our vessel for further study.

No matter which surface it is resting on, this apparatus will spin with great speed to the point where its center of gravity and momentum easily keeps it upright. We can detect no interior power source, and believe this may be a startling example of true perpetual motion.

Suddenly, it is gone.

The being has disappeared completely, leaving only the device behind.

The storm around us has lessened to the point where it may be safely navigated, though the sheer scale of the cosmic destruction left behind is staggering.

We pray they have found their way to a final peace.

With the entity gone, we felt confident enough to approach the device.

The material it is made of cannot be splintered or fractured away with any known equipment. However, there are a few external apparatuses magnetically attached to its outer casing, each spinning at an extremely high velocity. One in particular was loose, and though the return conditions are likely to be cramped, we were able to load it inside of our vessel for further study.

No matter which surface it is resting on, this apparatus will spin with great speed to the point where its center of gravity and momentum easily keeps it upright. We can detect no interior power source, and believe this may be a startling example of true perpetual motion.

note.zh: 风暴中心的存在消失，留下的装置上取下一个永不停转的部件；探索结束，获得遗珍“永旋陀螺”。
note.en: The being at the storm's eye vanishes; a part taken from the device it left spins forever; the exploration ends with the relic Ever Spinning Top.

texts.zh:
我们都认为不去招惹这个实体是明智的。

它操纵这台机器的能力对我们而言难以置信。

尽管维度仍难以计算，但我们确定它的一部分容易达到我们整个已知星系的大小。奇怪的是它对我们没有任何引力作用。

我们开始认为这个生物应该只是部分处于这个维度，我们只是在观测着它的附肢体。也许就像[explorer.GetSpeciesHandName]浸入水池当中一般。

我们的被动观察让产生了一些重要的科学问题，必能让我们的帝国大受裨益，如果这份报告能通过的话。
texts.en:
We agree it is wise to not attract the attention of this entity.

The power it must wield to manipulate this machine is inconceivable to us.

While dimensions are still difficult to calculate, we are certain that parts of it are easily the size of our entire known galaxy. Strangely, it pulls at us with no force of gravity.

We are beginning to think the being is only partly in this dimension, and we are witnessing only an appendage. Perhaps like an [explorer.GetSpeciesHandName] dipped into a pool of water.

Our passive observations have provided us with some important scientific questions that will surely benefit our empire greatly, provided this report makes its way through.

texts.en:
We agree it is wise to not attract the attention of this entity.

The power it must wield to manipulate this machine is inconceivable to us.

While dimensions are still difficult to calculate, we are certain that parts of it are easily the size of our entire known galaxy. Strangely, it pulls at us with no force of gravity.

We are beginning to think the being is only partly in this dimension, and we are witnessing only an appendage. Perhaps like an [explorer.GetSpeciesHandName] dipped into a pool of water.

Our passive observations have provided us with some important scientific questions that will surely haunt our empire's greatest minds for some time, provided this report makes its way through.

texts.zh:
我们直接把样品暴露在了明火中。

我们逐渐向溶液里引入越来越多的热量，直到后来我们确信明火也只是最多会扰乱它不稳定的化学平衡。

我们的发现是革命性的。

我们很确定可以利用这个发现来革新我们对舰船推进和通用能源生产的理解。
texts.en:
We have exposed the sample to direct flame.

We slowly introduced more and more heat to the solution, until we were confident a direct flame would be the least disruptive to its unstable chemical balance.

What we discovered is revolutionary.

We are certain we can use these findings to advance our understanding of not only ship propulsion, but energy generation in general.

texts.zh:
这是一个冒险的建议，但我们严格遵守了命令。

在几位船员的反对下，我们将样品直接暴露在火焰下。

我们逐渐向溶液里引入越来越多的热量，直到后来我们确信明火也只是最多会扰乱它不稳定的化学平衡。

我们的发现是革命性的。

我们很确定可以利用这个发现来革新我们对舰船推进和通用能源生产的理解。
texts.en:
A risky proposal, but we have followed our orders to the letter.

At the objection of several of our crew, we have exposed the sample to direct flame.

We slowly introduced more and more heat to the solution, until we were confident a direct flame would be the least disruptive to its unstable chemical balance.

What we discovered is revolutionary.

We are certain we can use these findings to advance our understanding of not only ship propulsion, but energy generation in general.

texts.zh:
我们与[explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural]失去了联系。

按照标准流程，我们拉回了锚链，取回了裂隙探球。

不幸的是我们只找到了完全焦炭化的残骸。

值得一提的是，整个船体内的空气充满了高浓度的星界物质。
texts.en:
We have lost contact with our [explorer.GetIndividualNamePlural].

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the anchor and recovered the Rift Sphere.

Unfortunately, we have found only charred remains.

Notably, the atmosphere inside of the vessel is high in concentration with astral material.

texts.zh:
我们与科研队失去了联系。

按照标准流程，我们拉回了锚链，取回了裂隙探球。

不幸的是我们只找到了完全焦炭化的整个船员团队。

值得一提的是，整个船体内的空气充满了高浓度的星界物质。
texts.en:
We have lost contact with the Science team.

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the anchor and recovered the Rift Sphere.

Unfortunately, we have found only the charred remains of the entire crew.

Notably, the atmosphere inside of the vessel is high in concentration with astral material.

note.zh: 失败分支：探球取回时只剩焦黑的遗骸，科学家死亡；获得奇异气体与大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: Failure branch: the recovered Sphere holds only charred remains and the scientist is killed; exotic gases and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

summary.text:
# 天顶 / The Vortex

- 分类 Category：星界裂隙 Astral rifts (C4) · DLC：星界位面 Astral Planes
- 来源 Sources：`common/astral_rifts/00_astral_rifts.txt:102`；`events/astral_rifts_0_events.txt:3488–3806`（900–940）
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（全篇 whole story；原独立的失败事件 915 已并入 / former standalone failure event 915 merged in）

## 如何开始 How it starts

裂隙类型从探索帝国的裂隙池中按权重抽取：权重 1。它能产出遗珍“永旋陀螺”，所以任一帝国正在探索它时，其他帝国抽到它的权重为 0（`00_astral_rifts.txt:102–116`）。每阶段结束掷 1–10 的骰子，加技能与线索、减难度，≥14 进入下一章；第一章 900 难度为 0。

Drawn by weight from the explorer's rift pool: weight 1. Because it can award the Ever Spinning Top relic, its weight is 0 for others while any empire explores it (`00_astral_rifts.txt:102–116`). Each phase ends with a d10 plus skill and clues minus difficulty; 14+ opens the next chapter. Chapter 900 has difficulty 0.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 天顶（900）：探球落入一场狂暴的旋风，采集到富含星界物质、对温度极敏感的气体样本（获得奇异气体）。继续前进（→ 905，难度 2）或用明火点燃样本（→ 910，难度 6）。
2. 明火实验是冒险的一步：突破则 910，获得工程研究与 10 年“天顶燃料”修正；若该阶段任一次掷骰失败（基础 1.5%/次）则 915“灾难”。
3. 更深入（920）：穿过风暴进入绝对平静的风暴眼；外面的“墙”是一整个正在互相碰撞的星系。
4. 遭遇（925）：风暴中心有一台难以理解的装置，和一个正在操纵它的存在。闪灯引起它注意（→ 930，难度 6：它停下，风暴减弱）或静静观测（→ 935，难度 2：它可能只有一部分处在这个维度）。
5. 倏然离去（940）：那个存在消失，只留下装置；取下一个永远旋转的部件。

1. The Vortex (900): the Sphere lands in a violent whirlwind and samples a gas rich in astral material and wildly sensitive to temperature (exotic gases). Proceed further (→ 905, difficulty 2) or expose the sample to flame (→ 910, difficulty 6).
2. The flame test is the risky step: a breakthrough gives 910 with engineering research and 10 years of Vortex Fuel; if any roll of that stage fails (base 1.5% per roll) the result is 915 “Catastrophe”.
3. Further Inside (920): through the storm into the perfectly calm eye; the storm's “wall” is an entire galaxy colliding with itself.
4. Encounter (925): at the centre stands an incomprehensible device and a being manipulating it. Flash lights to get its attention (→ 930, difficulty 6: it stops and the storm weakens) or observe quietly (→ 935, difficulty 2: it may exist only partly in this dimension).
5. It Leaves (940): the being vanishes, leaving the device; one part, spinning forever, is taken back.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 940：遗珍“永旋陀螺”，探索结束（两条观察路线都到这里）。
- 915（失败分支）：探球取回时只剩焦黑遗骸，科学家死亡；获得奇异气体与大量星界丝缕，探索结束。

- 940: the relic Ever Spinning Top; the exploration ends (both approaches lead here).
- 915 (failure branch): the recovered Sphere holds only charred remains and the scientist is killed; exotic gases and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 900、910、915、920、925、935 有格式塔版本文字；940 对唯心主义帝国多一句祈愿。

- 900, 910, 915, 920, 925 and 935 have gestalt texts; 940 adds a prayer line for spiritualist empires.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：裂隙定义与遗珍锁定；900–940 全部事件；900.b 的 `on_roll_failed = astral_rift.915`（`astral_rifts_0_events.txt:3517–3521`）。
- 修正：编译图漏掉失败分支，915 曾是独立故事；已用桥接 900.b → 915 并入，并标注 910/915 互斥。

- Checked: rift definition and relic lock; every event 900–940; `on_roll_failed = astral_rift.915` of 900.b (`astral_rifts_0_events.txt:3517–3521`).
- Correction: the compiled graph missed the failure branch and 915 had been a separate story; merged with the bridge 900.b → 915 and marked 910/915 as exclusive.
